items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: When I know John, he was playing with the Excelsior. And I was playing with the Excelsior. A fellow by the name of Yance was beatin' drum.

ctx.x: We want you to speak for them. They can't speak for themselves, so you tell us who some of them were.

He had his brother. His brother used to be a beat snare drum. Used to have a fellow beat bass drum. They called him Yance. Well, you wouldn't know the name. Their name wouldn't... What's his name? They used to call him Yance. That's the kind of Creole name. He got plenty of people around him.
Was he there before Clay Giles was playing bass drum?
